record.question: A pharmacist can support the demographic health goals by:
options: Encouraging early marriage so that couples can have more children
Discouraging contraception to keep the population at replacement level
Promoting awareness on different spacing methods
Promoting the use of termination pills for unplanned pregnancies
record.explanation: Answer C: Promoting awareness on different spacing methods. Pharmacists can support population-health goals by providing accurate information about contraception and birth-spacing methods. Reference: https://www.who.int/health-topics/family-planning. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
